question: Where does preventive care break down between recommended and completed in your setting?

responses.name: Md Shafaat Ali Choyon
responses.affiliation: Founder, HSREP; moderator of this roundtable
responses.text:
I am asking this because I have watched the break happen, though not in a U.S. clinic. At Praava Health in Dhaka I ran the diagnostics side of a primary-care network, and for years the pattern was the same: people started a test and did not finish it.

Three things did most of the damage. A price surprise at the next step, after the first test had been cheap. A positive result that arrived with no appointment attached, so the urgency never landed. And a second visit that was hard to make, because of distance, or a day off work that nobody could spare.

That is one person's experience of one system, not a finding. I expect the U.S. version is different in its details and the same in its shape, and that is what I want to learn from you. Where, in your setting, does the person stop?
